import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router'; import { ContentService, PortfolioData } from '../../services/content.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-navbar', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive], templateUrl: './navbar.component.html' }) export class NavbarComponent implements OnInit { content!: PortfolioData; isMobileMenuOpen: boolean = false; constructor(private contentService: ContentService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.contentService.content$.subscribe(data => { this.content = data; }); } }
